title: Angle Between Hands of a Clock
description:
Given two numbers, hour and minutes , return the smaller angle (in degrees) formed between the hour and the minute hand . 
 
 Answers within 10 -5 of the actual value will be accepted as correct. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/12/26/sample_1_1673.png] 
 
```
Input:
 hour = 12, minutes = 30

Output:
 165
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/12/26/sample_2_1673.png] 
 
```
Input:
 hour = 3, minutes = 30

Output:
 75
```

 Example 3: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2019/12/26/sample_3_1673.png] 
 
```
Input:
 hour = 3, minutes = 15

Output:
 7.5
```

 Constraints: 

 1 <= hour <= 12 
 
 0 <= minutes <= 59
